name: Safehaus
blurb: A live-in residency for biosecurity founders in San Francisco — thesis, program calendar, partners and an open application.

name: Taser Knife Fight Club
blurb: A fight night for pun-wrestlers: invented roster, tale-of-the-tape stats, a bout card and a challenger form. None of it is real.

name: Io Protocol
blurb: A specification for a personal chief-of-staff agent, built on a four-tier authority model that routes actions by consequence rather than confidence.

name: Fund OS Protocol
blurb: An operating protocol for running a venture fund on a CRM: table architecture, automations, permissions and the conventions that keep records current.

name: Biopunk Discord Runbook
blurb: An audit and rebuild of a residency community's Discord — channel and role architecture, moderation policy, and an onboarding flow.

name: Pun Bearable — Kickstarter Playbook
blurb: A complete Kickstarter build-out for a party card game: positioning, printer shortlist, pledge ladder, funnel math and timeline.

name: Elliot's Tabs
blurb: A searchable dashboard over a few hundred open browser tabs, sorted into categories and tagged by what is genuinely actionable.

name: Core Facility Finder
blurb: A search tool over academic core facilities — filter by capability and country, then generate a templated outreach email per facility.

name: Accelerator Landscape Audit
blurb: Twelve accelerators compared on check size, equity and funnel, turned into a concrete set of fixes for the Biopunk site.

name: Test Coverage Audit — 19 Repositories
blurb: Nineteen repositories scanned for test suites and CI gating, with the gaps written up repo by repo.
